purpose: Production source views for the commuter train kit. Fills the two gaps found by the class/model sweep: a clean trailer side without the pantograph that leaked into the pilot's intermediate view, and a seed sweep of the cab front so the acceptance gate (head-on ratio within 10% and symmetry above 0.75) can pick a usable face. Cab and motor sides are reused from train-pilot.
commonPrompt: Strict orthographic technical elevation of one single Japanese electric commuter train car, rendered as a photograph-quality flat texture, exact profile, camera perpendicular to the car at half its height, zero perspective, not a three-quarter view. The whole car is in sharp focus edge to edge, no depth of field, no floor and no shadow under the car, seamless uniform pale gray backdrop, soft even diffuse lighting without bright specular highlights. Realistic factory finish and fine credible details: roof ribs, air-conditioner boxes, gangway, door leaves with window panes, continuous side window band, grab handles, bogies with wheels and brake discs, couplers. Generic contemporary Japanese commuter design, warm ivory-white body, a deep teal waist stripe, dark grey underframe and bogie, silver-grey roof. No logos, no operator marks, no readable text and no licence or car numbers. Clean reference for texturing a miniature Tokyo street model.
sideSuffix: Camera exactly level with the axle centre line, roof surface and tyre treads not visible, the car spans the full image width, all wheels resting on one horizontal baseline.
frontSuffix: Exact head-on front elevation, camera level with the middle of the car, zero perspective, the entire front face is visible and centred, no side, no roof and no wheels visible. Symmetric left and right about the vertical centre line.
negativeBase: perspective, three-quarter view, angled view, logo, badge, emblem, operator mark, readable text, letters, destination text, licence plate, car number, watermark, cast shadow, ground shadow, floor, reflections, people, background scenery, cropped vehicle, multiple cars, two trains, model kit, illustration, painting

views.role: intermediate trailer car, side elevation, no pantograph
views.prompt: Intermediate trailer car of a Japanese commuter EMU, 20 m long and 3.6 m tall, seen in exact side elevation, both ends plain and vertical with full-height gangway connections and no cab. Four evenly spaced passenger double doors along the body, each with two tall windows, and a continuous dark window band between them. A completely plain, flat, uninterrupted silver-grey roof carrying only a row of low rectangular air-conditioner boxes and no pantograph, no roof-mounted pantograph, no electrical gantry. Two bogies near the ends, each with two wheels. The teal waist stripe runs the full length at mid height.

views.role: driving cab car, head-on front elevation
views.prompt: Head-on front of a Japanese commuter EMU driving cab, 2.95 m wide and 3.6 m tall. A large two-pane black-framed windscreen across the upper half, a lit rectangular destination rollsign box directly above it under the roof edge, two round warm-white headlamps low at the outer corners, two small red tail lamps beside them, a teal band sweeping across the body below the windscreen, a black lower skirt with a central automatic coupler, and a silver-grey roof edge above with the top of an air-conditioner box. Symmetric about the vertical centre line.

criteria: Orthographic: no visible perspective or three-quarter view; wheels share one baseline on side views.
Trailer: a plain continuous roof with no pantograph or gantry.
Front head-on: width/height within 10% of 0.81 and mirror symmetry above 0.75.
Flat lighting and easy matting against the plain backdrop.
